changed_in.5.2: Rejects a `pos` outside `1` to `#list + 1`, and always returns exactly one value; 5.1 checks no bounds and accepts only `1` to `#list` — every other position, including `#list + 1` and the default on an empty list, returns no value at all and leaves the list untouched.
